title: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Notting Hill)
content_text:
DPM Consulting Group website (read 4 Oct 2026 AEDT): Melbourne land development engineering consultancy. Services: civil engineering design and documentation; project management; construction management; water resources; urban development; land capability studies. Projects: residential, industrial and commercial land development. Contact published for applications: consulting@dpmvic.com.au, phone (03) 9538 5000, 22 Business Park Drive Notting Hill VIC 3168.
Current public vacancies page also lists experienced water resources engineer (send resume to consulting@dpmvic.com.au). No dated junior vacancy verified this tick; this record is a speculative enquiry to the employer-published consulting inbox for early-career civil design / documentation support.
apply_instructions: Email CV and cover note to consulting@dpmvic.com.au (published contact for applications).
